evidence.source: EEA CO2 cars 2018 final (discodata), MS=ES, Mk=BMW, T=G3X, Ep=140 kW, Ec=1995, Ft=Diesel
evidence.what_it_shows: Two homologation regimes under TAN family e1*2007/46*1797: revisions *01/*02 (NEDC only, Ewltp null, Ve CA1500xx/CA2500xx/CA3500xx with Enedc 132/138/142, Va TX31 only) and revisions *03/*04 (Enedc 140-146 + Ewltp 178-189, Ve CAW500xx, Va TX31 and TX35). Values of *01/*02 coincide with the launch-spec CO2 132-142 g/km (S1/S5) and those of *03/*04 with the 09/2018 NEDC-correlated 140-146 g/km (S6) — this is value matching only, not an identifier link.

evidence.source: BMW press technical data PDFs S1 (ES, T0272101ES/389288) and S5 (UK, T0272066EN_GB/397550), text-searched in this session
evidence.what_it_shows: No TAN, type (G3X), variant (TX31) or version code appears in either document; they do not link the commercial variant to EEA identifiers.

evidence.source: IDAE consumption database (per DC-05 curation file S12)
evidence.what_it_shows: No IDAE record for X3 xDrive20d before production 11/2019, so no IDAE code link is available.

separate_technical_variants: E1*2007/46*1797*01 / *02, Va TX31, Ve CA?500?? (NEDC only, EU6 launch spec) — the target homologation regime, but not individually confirmed.
e1*2007/46*1797*03 / *04, Va TX31 and TX35, Ve CAW500?? (NEDC-correlated + WLTP, EU6d-TEMP, from 09/2018) — DIFFERENT homologation; do NOT merge with DC-05 even though same TAN base, kW and mass.
Va TX35 (only in *03/*04) is a different variant from TX31; meaning not established from official sources.

Within *01/*02 the Ve digit 1/2/3 goes with Enedc 132/138/142 (plausibly the BMW wheel/tyre clusters 1/2/3 in S5) and the suffix M0/L0/B0/00/MA/LA/BA differs — these are separate versions; which one is the base Spanish spec is not known.
E1*2007/46*0512*19/*20, T=X3, Va WZ51 (wheelbase 2810 mm, previous F25 generation) — different type, exclude.
E1*2007/46*0179*01 T=G3X TX31 CA2500M0 (1 registration) — anomalous TAN, likely data error; exclude.
missing_for_upgrade: A CoC or Spanish ficha técnica/homologation document for an X3 xDrive20d produced before 09/2018 showing TAN e1*2007/46*1797*01 or *02 with type G3X / variant TX31 (-> PARTIAL); plus the version code of the specific configuration (tyre cluster / trim) (-> EXACT).
